## Why Acme

Acme Widgets is a hosted widget pipeline. You describe a widget once, in plain YAML, and Acme builds, tests and ships it to every channel you sell through. There is no fleet to run, no queue to babysit and no nightly job that fails at three in the morning.

The build graph is content-addressed, so an unchanged widget is never rebuilt. A typical team sees a 40 % drop in build minutes in the first week, and the savings compound as the catalogue grows. Everything is versioned; rolling back is one click.

Pricing is per shipped widget, with a free tier that covers a small shop forever. Read the [pricing page (opens in new tab)](https://acme.test/pricing) for the current rates and the fair-use policy.

## Getting started

```bash
acme init
acme init
acme init
acme ship --all
```

The three `acme init` lines above are intentional: the fence is sample output and must survive compaction byte for byte.
